senses.definition: A sturdy bag, often used to hold things such as grain, potatoes, or other supplies.

senses.definition: Feeling unhappy or full of sorrow.

senses.definition: A seat fitted onto a horse, bicycle, or similar thing.

senses.definition: Protected from danger, or unlikely to cause harm.

senses.definition: Being protected from harm, or the steps people take to protect someone.

senses.definition: Exactly alike or the very one already talked about.

senses.definition: A small part or measurement taken from something larger.

senses.definition: Assignments or other work students do as part of school.
